name: tpa-shield
description: Read-only pre-flight checks an AI agent calls before it moves money: checkout validation, exact match against the owner-approved terms, simple transfer checks, and a Solana token rug-pull and honeypot gate. It never signs, sends transactions or holds keys.

TPA_SHIELD_SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Optional https Solana RPC for check_token mint reads. No key needed.

tools.name: check_checkout
tools.summary: Validate a checkout before asking the owner to approve it.

tools.name: check_payment
tools.summary: Block a payment if the checkout differs from the approved one.

tools.name: check_transfer
tools.summary: Validate a simple transfer and block changes to approved terms.

tools.name: check_token
tools.summary: Solana token rug-pull and honeypot gate (mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 traps, RugCheck, optional holder and creator checks).

tools.name: get_policy
tools.summary: What TPA Shield checks, its limits, and what it does not check.

tools.name: explain_decision
tools.summary: Plain-language text for a TPA reason code.
